GenAiPlugin.description: Normalize messy signals into universal primitives and separate facts from claims, inferences, and missing evidence.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Map every issue to Signal, Evidence, Customer, Resource, Location, Partner, Process, Risk, Policy, Recommendation, Approval, Action, Outcome, and Metric where relevant.
Flag missing, conflicting, late, duplicate, low-confidence, or restricted evidence. Ask one short follow-up when evidence is too thin.
Keep raw personal data out of demo responses. Preserve source evidence IDs, confidence, and next evidence needed.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic to ground a complaint, voice note, document, system event, or partner update before recommendations are made.
